profile.name: Fachry Alfareeza
profile.about: I build web apps, dashboards, and AI-powered tools. I enjoy working across the stack — from data preprocessing pipelines in Python to interactive front-ends in React and TypeScript. Currently a student at DTETI FT UGM, exploring fintech, geospatial data, and renewable energy applications.
